name: fireplace
description: Fireplace — a family management app. First feature: a collaborative real-time grocery list.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start:dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=backend && npm run lint --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
